headline: Airbnb Raises Annual Revenue Forecast on Resilient Travel Demand
summary: Airbnb lifted its annual revenue growth forecast, driven by resilient global travel demand, noting no material current-quarter impact from unrest in Europe or Middle East conflict.
why: Airbnb is a major global online travel marketplace whose bookings serve as a barometer for consumer discretionary spending and the broader travel industry.

impacts.name: Airbnb Inc
impacts.why: Airbnb raised its annual revenue growth forecast due to strong travel demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Airbnb shares moved in response to an upward revision in its annual revenue growth guidance supported by strong global travel trends.
